blinding_guess.why: The gp_origin publisher and set_gp_origin subscriber use the same type (geographic_msgs/GeoPointStamped), scale latitude/longitude by 1E7 in matching directions, and convert altitude AMSL->ellipsoid on publish and ellipsoid->AMSL on subscribe, which matches the GeoPoint definition (altitude above the WGS 84 ellipsoid). Nothing in the listed elements looks inconsistent.

notes: ROS 1 (melodic): all QoS values null; publisher uses queue size 10 and latch=true (global_position.cpp:88), subscriber queue size 10 (line 89); no rate set (gp_origin is published once per received MAVLink GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN, stamp ros::Time::now() at line 230). Topic names are relative to the private handle gp_nh("~global_position"); the /mavros prefix comes from the node name 'mavros' in launch/node.launch:15, so it would change if the node were renamed. Frame: 'earth' is the default of parameter tf/global_frame_id (line 71), also set in px4_config.yaml/apm_config.yaml; it is overridable at run time. The GeoPoint and GeoPointStamped.position field ports take the frame of the enclosing gp_origin message header, since the plugin writes these fields only in handle_gps_global_origin (lines 226-236). For the consumed set_gp_origin, header.frame_id is never read (set_gp_origin_cb lines 482-496), so its frame is recorded null; the callback treats position.altitude as ellipsoid height and converts it to AMSL for MAVLink SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN; time_boot_ms is left unset (TODO comment, line 489). geoid_to_ellipsoid_height/ellipsoid_to_geoid_height return 0.0 when the egm96_5 geoid is not loaded (mavros/include/mavros/mavros_uas.h:250-268). Dependency definitions (geographic_msgs GeoPoint.msg, GeoPointStamped.msg; std_msgs Header.msg) are not in the snapshot; they were fetched as raw files from ros-geographic-info/geographic_info and ros/std_msgs into a scratch directory outside the workspace. The exact melodic release tag was not determined; the fetchable tags 0.5.4, 0.5.5, 0.5.6 (geographic_info) and 0.5.11, 0.5.12 (std_msgs) give byte-identical files and identical hashes. To let definition_hash.py resolve package names, a one-line package.xml containing only <name> was written next to each fetched msg directory (it does not enter the hash). Field elements belong to a dependency package; this package provides them by populating them (declares lists the type as written in the fetched definition). references is limited to the consumed packet element; the plugin also subscribes to ~home_position/home (mavros_msgs/HomePosition), which is not a packet element.
